newsitem.title: USA: L.L. Knickerbocker to buy doll maker.
newsitem.headline: L.L. Knickerbocker to buy doll maker.

text.p: The L.L. Knickerbocker Co Inc said on Monday it entered into a letter of intent to acquire Georgetown Collection Inc for an undisclosed combination of stock and debt.

Maine-based Georgetown Collection develops and markets, high quality porcelain dolls. L.L. Knickerbocker said also intended to acquire Georgetown subsidiary Magic Attic Press Inc. The two units had estimated combined annual sales of $35 million and an active customer base of over 200,000, it said.

The Magic Attic Club develops and markets a book-and-doll product line, sold through a catalog, based on four girls and their adventures. Magic Attic Press Inc publishes illustrated novels based on the girls. It had over 1.5 million copies in print, L.L. Knickerbocker said.

The acquisitions, made for a combination of L.L. Knickerbocker stock, warrants, senior notes and assumption of debt, included two leased 40,000 square foot facilities, inventory, receivables, mailing lists, computer hardware and software and trademarks and copyrights, the company said.
The company said the acquisition would increase company annual sales to an estimated $80 million.
